neighbours.label: a small set of tokens: ' rang' (as in rangefinder or the bell rang), 'izz' (in 'quizz') and ' prevailing'; the same sentences with related words that tokenize differently stay low
fire: The gunner checked the rangefinder before every shot across the bay.
The telephone rang three times before anyone answered it.
Our teacher handed out a short quizz on fractions this morning.
Under the prevailing conditions, the harvest was delayed by a week.
The hunters bought a laser rangefinder for the autumn season.
The church bells rang out across the valley at noon.
My brother made a music quizz for the party on Saturday.
The prevailing view among doctors has changed over the last decade.
quiet: The gunner checked the binoculars before every shot across the bay.
The telephone rings three times before the machine answers it.
Our teacher handed out a short quiz on fractions this morning.
Under the current conditions, the harvest was delayed by a week.
The hunters bought a laser scope for the autumn season.
The church bells ring out across the valley at noon.
My brother made a music quiz for the party on Saturday.
The dominant view among doctors has changed over the last decade.

notes: Layer-0 pole with broad flag. Card peaks: ' rang' x3, ' Voy', 'izz', ' causing', ' prevailing'. Probe: 'rangefinder' 0.629, 'quizz' 0.611, 'carbon dioxide is causing' 0.535 but 'storm was causing delays' below 0.057 (so ' causing' is left out), 'bell rang' 0.348, 'prevailing winds' 0.272, 'Voyager' below 0.04. Near misses use ring/rings, quiz, rule, dominant.
